newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals weak on poor industrial demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals weak on poor industrial demand.

text.p: Base metals turned weak on the local market on Wednesday, dealers said.
"Sluggish industrial demand and fresh arrivals of the imported metals kept market subdued," one dealer said.

Ready nickel fell by 100 rupees to 37,500 rupees per quintal. Nickel was up by 200 rupees on Tuesday and by 200 rupees on Monday. "Demand resistance triggered profit-taking at the higher level," a dealer said.
Copper slid 50 rupees to 11,650 rupees per quintal while lead fell by 50 rupees to 4,800 rupees and aluminium fell by 25 rupees to 7,200 rupees per quintal.
